cityCacheWarm.protocol: Fresh Playwright browser context; city API responses are replayed from the checked-in OSM fixture

networkTelemetry.scope: browser-visible requests on the measured street page; excludes server-side upstream fetches

unavailableMeasurements.name: estimatedGpuMemoryBytes
unavailableMeasurements.reason: WebGL does not expose reliable allocated VRAM bytes; geometry and texture object counts are reported instead.

unavailableMeasurements.name: ktx2GpuUploadCompletionMs
unavailableMeasurements.reason: WebGL exposes synchronous upload submission but not a portable completion timestamp; GPU residency is estimated from transcoded compressed mip payloads.

unavailableMeasurements.name: ktx2WasmCompileMs
unavailableMeasurements.reason: Three.js 0.170.0 compiles Basis WASM inside KTX2Loader workers; its public API does not expose compile and transcode timings separately.
